!.notes: Not implemented (some spellings are recognized only to report an error).

ascii.notes: Not implemented (some spellings are recognized only to report an error).

binary.notes: Implemented binary transfer mode; no argument arity validation.

bye.notes: Basic command implemented; full upstream argument, output and session semantics have not been verified.

call.notes: Not implemented (some spellings are recognized only to report an error).

cd.notes: Directory argument required; no implicit home directory.

checksum.notes: Not implemented (some spellings are recognized only to report an error).

chmod.notes: Octal permissions; no full upstream permission syntax or recursion.

close.notes: Single connection only; no indexed session close.

copyid.notes: Not implemented (some spellings are recognized only to report an error).

cp.notes: Not implemented (some spellings are recognized only to report an error).

dir.notes: Directory listing; no upstream file-mask path behavior across all backends.

echo.notes: Plain token output; no full upstream switch/parameter/environment expansion semantics.

exit.notes: Basic command implemented; full upstream argument, output and session semantics have not been verified.

get.notes: Binary recursive transfers and offset resume; no WinSCP file masks, ASCII/automatic mode, speed limit, transfer presets, or full resume policy.

help.notes: General help only; no per-command help or abbreviation resolution.

keepuptodate.notes: Not implemented (some spellings are recognized only to report an error).

lcd.notes: Basic command implemented; full upstream argument, output and session semantics have not been verified.

lls.notes: Local directories and simple wildcard masks; names-only output, not upstream formatting.

ln.notes: Not implemented (some spellings are recognized only to report an error).

lpwd.notes: Basic command implemented; full upstream argument, output and session semantics have not been verified.

ls.notes: Directory listing; no upstream file-mask path behavior across all backends.

man.notes: General help only; no per-command help or abbreviation resolution.

mget.notes: Binary recursive transfers and offset resume; no WinSCP file masks, ASCII/automatic mode, speed limit, transfer presets, or full resume policy.

mkdir.notes: Basic command implemented; full upstream argument, output and session semantics have not been verified.

mput.notes: Binary recursive transfers and offset resume; same transfer option gaps as get.

mv.notes: One source and one destination only.

open.notes: URL sessions only; no stored sites, raw settings, SSH tunnels or session selection.

option.notes: Confirm, batch and resume supported; binary only. Reconnect, echo, failonnomatch, include/exclude and other upstream options are not implemented. Batch abort stops subsequent commands, not necessarily remaining files within a command.

put.notes: Binary recursive transfers and offset resume; same transfer option gaps as get.

pwd.notes: Basic command implemented; full upstream argument, output and session semantics have not been verified.

recv.notes: Binary recursive transfers and offset resume; no WinSCP file masks, ASCII/automatic mode, speed limit, transfer presets, or full resume policy.

rename.notes: One source and one destination only.

rm.notes: File removal; no recursive directory deletion or upstream switches.

rmdir.notes: One empty directory only, not multiple arguments.

send.notes: Binary recursive transfers and offset resume; same transfer option gaps as get.

session.notes: Not implemented (some spellings are recognized only to report an error).

stat.notes: Basic command implemented; full upstream argument, output and session semantics have not been verified.

symlink.notes: Not implemented (some spellings are recognized only to report an error).

synchronize.notes: Recursive timestamp-based copy; lacks criteria, mirror, preview, filters and conflict handling. Both is sequential copying, not an upstream synchronization planner.

features.name: SFTP
features.notes: Native PuTTY transport on POSIX; Windows uses curl. Extension negotiation, links, remote copy/checksum, full metadata and backend equivalence remain unverified.

features.name: SCP
features.notes: Delegated to curl, whose SCP support depends on its build; no WinSCP shell-based directory and command engine.

features.name: FTP/FTPS
features.notes: curl transport and listing parser; no full upstream MLSD, TLS configuration, active/passive and server compatibility validation.

features.name: WebDAV
features.notes: Generic HTTP listing parsing, not DAV PROPFIND XML; incomplete directory/property semantics.

features.name: Amazon S3
features.notes: s3 URLs currently become HTTPS; no AWS SigV4 signing, credentials/region configuration or S3 bucket/object listing implementation.

features.name: Transfers
features.notes: Basic binary recursion/resume; missing masks, text conversion, bandwidth limits, reconnect/retry, robust atomic transfer and full metadata policies.

features.name: Synchronization
features.notes: Sequential recursive copying; missing plan/preview, criteria, mirror, watch mode, exclusions and conflict-safe bidirectional synchronization.

features.name: Sessions/configuration
features.notes: No persistent site manager, multiple core sessions, session import/export or full configuration model.

features.name: Security/authentication
features.notes: POSIX passwords, keys, agent and host-key checks exist. GSSAPI is disabled; SSH tunnels, proxy UI/settings and curl pin equivalence need work. GUI defaults to wildcard host key.

features.name: GUI
features.notes: Browser Commander layout and background jobs exist; no full Commander/Explorer equivalence, tabs/site manager, advanced queue controls or reconnecting persistent sessions.

features.name: Editing/search
features.notes: No integrated remote editor, save/upload monitoring, full remote search or custom command system.

features.name: Automation
features.notes: Subset console scripting; no WinSCP .NET assembly/PowerShell API or structured XML action log and full parameter expansion.

features.name: Desktop integration
features.notes: Debian launcher/icons and terminal launch exist; no full upstream drag/drop, shell integration or extension system.

features.name: Localization/accessibility
features.notes: No equivalent upstream translation catalog and desktop accessibility verification.

features.name: Packaging/platforms
features.notes: Make/CMake and Debian/Windows builds exist; Windows curl may lack SSH protocols. Native builds do not establish functional parity.
